inspiration.adaptation: Categorized collection, progressive rule loading, structured scaffolds and fact verification adapted to Android frontend source. No Go conventions or assumed retry/security policy.

questions: Which reusable definition owns state and shared dependencies?
verification: One declared owner; existing endpoints; source-bound bindings; shared definitions referenced once

questions: Who writes state, for how long?
verification: Action/state/scenario IDs mapped; expressions occur in linked source spans; branch cases and event ownership reviewed

questions: Which data input, API or persistence dependency is used?
Is implementation available in the approved snapshot?
verification: Resolve dependency once; source-unavailable internals remain unresolved; do not infer retries/auth/defaults
Separate observed normal return from absent catch/finally and unknown library cancellation; bind branch expressions

questions: Which guards and invalid-input branches exist?
Which platform permission/security APIs are called?
verification: Check concrete source condition and outcomes; never infer a policy from a name

questions: Is evidence source reasoning or an executed test?
verification: Resolve exact source/test spans and test symbols; source provenance does not certify semantic completeness or runtime parity
